name: Whitereach Post
summary: Horde travelers find rest at Whitereach Post beside the canyon path in Thousand Needles. Near Camp E'thok, the small camp overlooks the harsh road between Feralas and the salt flats beneath the sandstone pillars.

sections.title: A Waystation in the Canyons
sections.body: Whitereach Post watches over the canyon road through Thousand Needles. Near Camp E'thok, this modest Horde foothold is one of several posts in the rugged wastes. Scouts monitor travel along the canyon floor between the mesas. Couriers and travelers crossing the contested wastes can stop here, though the post has fewer defenses than the great lift or the major tribal settlements.

faq.answer: Whitereach Post is a small Horde outpost beside Thousand Needles' main canyon path, near Camp E'thok.
The Horde controls Whitereach Post, where tauren scouts watch the gorge trails.

faq.q: Who can be found stationed here?
faq.answer: Horde scouts and wanderers are stationed at Whitereach Post. Kanati Greycloud, a tauren, watches the canyon passage.

angles.text: As a Horde traveler, you can rest at Whitereach Post while scouts keep watch over Thousand Needles' perilous canyons.
As a tauren, you help secure this roadside camp, where tribesfolk traveling between Mulgore, Feralas, and the Shimmering Flats can rest.
